notes.title: Advanced Crypto System
notes.content:
Our game will continue to develop and progress constantly. We are announcing this nice feature that will be added to our game soon:

[b]Crypto Factory[/b]



[b][i]From this section, you can get security software against cyber attacks to your coin.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447815/ab09c3574fd19b29c82f6bb630dcf8e6224e4100.png[/img]

[i][b]You can see the price evaluations of your crypto currency in the past periods.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447815/d03a3231b9c6b1ffcc721be7d9440183a8f7ce32.png[/img]

[i][b]You can increase its value by buying buff software for your crypto money.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447815/d079c8560ea45d778dd14dc79e065c71012e70a6.png[/img]



[b]Other panels are still in development. When this development is finished, features such as purchasable hardware and production control panel will be announced.[/b]

[b]Best Regards.[/b]
